licences.notes: Written out from the printed pages: sung lines and piano each read by two independent readers, every disagreement settled on the page by a judge, a separate sweep for dynamics and other marks, then checked bar by bar by a fresh checker (clean). The German singing translation, instrument cues and the stage direction “(feurig)” are left out; the misprint “fedc” in bar 1 is read as “fede”. The last bar is printed as a one-quarter bar: it holds Ferrando's upbeat “Scioc-che-” into the next recitative, which is not part of this piece's phrases. Playback tempo half note = 97 (♩ = 194), from the lengths of three complete recordings (Böhm, Gardiner, Barenboim; median 1:07); Mozart gives the word Allegro only.
